import sys, os, hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
from types import ModuleType
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
rc = R24.rc
print(placement.VERSION, hashlib.sha256(open(placement.__file__, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:8])
D = '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/docs/implementation/c2a-r30/'
OLD = {}
for n, f in [('r29', '/root/worktrees/send-merge/backend/dealroom_sign/placement.py'), ('r28', D + 'r28-source.py.txt'), ('r21', D + 'r21-source.py.txt')]:
    m = ModuleType('old_' + n); m.__file__ = placement.__file__; sys.modules[m.__name__] = m
    exec(compile(open(f).read(), m.__name__, 'exec'), m.__dict__); OLD[n] = m
pat = dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for p in (24, 30, 40):
        for g in (24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 54):
            for right in (False, True):
                rows = [(150, 'DISCLOSER:', False, 72), (162, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, 72),
                        (200, 'By:', True, 72, 272), (200 + p, 'Date:', True, 72, 272),
                        (200 + p + g, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, 72)]
                if right:
                    rows += [(150, 'RECIPIENT:', False, 340), (162, 'HARBOR LIGHT ANALYTICS, INC.', False, 340),
                             (200, 'By:', True, 340, 540), (200 + p, 'Date:', True, 340, 540)]
                pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), rows])
                mo = Mock(); r = placement.place(pdf, [pat], model_client=mo)
                lines = sorted({tuple(f['evidence']['line']) for f in r['fields']})
                old = ' '.join(f"{n}:{in_process(m, pdf, [pat], Mock())['status']}" for n, m in OLD.items())
                print(f'pitch {p} gap {g} HLA-block-right {right!s:5} | r30 worker {r["status"]} {r["reason_code"]} fields {len(r["fields"])} lines {lines} model {mo.call_count} | {old}')
print('http', http.call_count)
